import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    if n == 0:
        print()
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    arr.sort()
    
    if k >= n - 1:
        arr.reverse()
    else:
        first_part = arr[:k+1]
        second_part = arr[k+1:]
        second_part.reverse()
        arr = first_part + second_part
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
